claims.statement: The hook exposes its documented public behavior through a stable versioned entrypoint.
A pointercancel abandons the gesture instead of performing the armed action.
Travel is reported in pixels and keeps growing past the final threshold.
The release decision is measured from where the gesture began, so closing asks for the same travel that opening did.

component.purpose: Turns a pointer stream into staged, axis-locked travel with a velocity-aware release.
component.title: Swipe gesture
